verdict.rationale: A data-use or AI-training policy is a fair privacy question for a GPU cloud marketplace, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documented opt-out, policy, or contractual commitment that customer data won't be used to train AI models. The nearest items are adjacent security features: key-only SSH, exclusive GPU access, and ISO 27001 Secure Cloud datacenters. None of these address training-data use, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
